userStories.title: Heartbeat service -- tick logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core heartbeat service that executes ticks: checks active hours, invokes agent, detects HEARTBEAT_OK, records results, and creates a new chat thread on escalation.
acceptanceCriteria: New file backend/src/services/heartbeat.py with HeartbeatService class
Constructor accepts user_id: str and optional store: BaseStore, initializes HeartbeatConfigRepo, HeartbeatStateRepo, HeartbeatHistoryRepo
HEARTBEAT_OK_TOKEN = 'HEARTBEAT_OK' module constant
_is_within_active_hours(config) checks current time against active_hours with timezone support via zoneinfo.ZoneInfo, handles midnight wrapping (e.g., 22:00-06:00)
_detect_heartbeat_ok(response, ack_max_chars) returns True if HEARTBEAT_OK appears at start or end of stripped response AND remaining content length <= ack_max_chars

tick() method: 1) Load config (skip if None or disabled), 2) Check active hours (skip if outside), 3) Build prompt replacing {checklist}, 4) Invoke agent via scheduled_llm_invoke() with cheapest model (Haiku) and source:'heartbeat' metadata, 5) Detect HEARTBEAT_OK -> action 'ok' or 'escalated', 6) On escalation create new chat thread, 7) Record state + history
_record_result() updates HeartbeatState: last_run_at, last_result, total_ticks, consecutive_ok_count (resets on escalation), total_escalations, next_due_at
Escalation rate limiting: if last escalation was < 15 minutes ago (via HeartbeatState.last_escalation_at), store result but skip thread creation
History stores escalations only: _record_result() only appends to HeartbeatHistory when action == 'escalated'. OK and skipped ticks update HeartbeatState counters only
CRUD methods: get_config(), save_config(), delete_config() (calls unregister() first), get_state(), get_history(limit=20)

make test passes
